meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码库、命令或改动拆成一步步图解,讲给完全不懂的人听
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队里有人不是工程师,却需要快速弄懂某段代码或某次改动。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if someone on your team must grasp code without being an engineer.

howto.what: 它会先读懂代码对人到底做了什么,把答案压成一句话,再在 PR Lens 画布上逐块展开:先两块,再加下一块,最后才给出全貌。产出是一个链接,你打开按下播放即可。
howto.when: 当你输入 /eli5 <对象>,或要求把代码讲给新手、非工程师听时,它就接管。

say.text: /eli5 这个拉取请求,像讲给新人一样
say.note: 生成可播放的讲解画布链接
一步一步加上新的部分

howto.what_en: It reads the code until it can say what it does for a person in one sentence, then builds a PR Lens canvas that grows one part at a time and shows the whole picture last. You get a link to press play on.
howto.when_en: Triggers with /eli5 <thing>, or when you ask for code explained simply, for a beginner, a new hire, or a non-engineer.

say_en.note: Walks through the whole picture step by step.

say_en.text: /eli5 this pull request, like I'm a new hire
say_en.note: Gives you a playable canvas link.

say_en.text: /eli5 src/queue.ts, I don't know this code
say_en.note: Adds one new part per step.
